openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything besides the wait and the ride (fare, cooldown, Trail, Alert exposure at watched stations)?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 says time only; the timetable prices only wait + ride, so any other cost is undecided here.

openQuestions.question: Are there limits on who may ride (e.g. wanted persons, armed cells, injured members)?
openQuestions.why: The GDD says board at any stop, with no restriction stated; none is assumed.

openQuestions.question: Is the interchange walk pace (1.4 m/s, [S]) acceptable, and is the wait for the next service after a change counted when pricing an order?
openQuestions.why: The GDD states no walking pace; journey totals exclude the wait at each change.

notes: T1 speed 8 m/s: stops 300-500 m apart on a street-running double track with 25-50 m radii; runs of about 39 s read as street running. Dwell 15 s, headway 120 s [S].
S1 speed 12 m/s: elevated, 24 m high, so faster than the tram and the quick option. Dwell 12 s, headway 90 s [S].
S2 speed 12 m/s, dwell 12 s, headway 90 s [S]: same elevated mode as S1, so it keeps the same values. It has only two stations, 305 m apart. Its end loops have no stops.
Interchange pairs: T1/circus with S1/circus (about 119 m) and T1/records with S2/market (about 72 m). Both are within the 150 m standard.
The previous proposal had no S2 line and no S2 journeys. This round adds both, with journeys that use the second interchange.
Journeys cover each tram end to each sky rail end in both directions, plus single-line rides. Code derives run times and totals; none are stated here.
Not decided and not invented: fares, cooldowns, rider limits (see openQuestions). The scale and loop questions in the plan notes belong to Datum.
